summary: #chat reaches rumors.c:doconsult() for the peaceful Oracle. At zero-based step 33, the hero has no gold, so C prints “You have no gold.” and returns ECMD_OK before prompting or charging. JavaScript currently throws at the MS_ORACLE arm before these guards. Port the whole doconsult() function and wire that arm; major consultations still depend on the unported outoracle() path and its oracle-list state.

source.branch: sounds.c:domonnoise() selects MS_ORACLE and calls doconsult(mtmp). The recorded branch has a nonnull peaceful Oracle and money_cnt(gi.invent) == 0, so doconsult() takes its no-gold guard after setting gm.multi = 0 and returns ECMD_OK. The whole function also owns minor and major consultation prompts, payment, event flags, experience, and wisdom exercise.

sounds.c:dochat() returns domonnoise(mtmp) for the selected adjacent monster; sounds.c:dotalk() calls dochat(), and cmd.c maps #chat to dotalk().
